meta.note: Two mappings used by the Ocean 10 views of the employer-skills chart (the skills widget on porttack.com, copied to /standards/mate/skills-match/). Neither the Ocean Decade nor Evaluate-Compete links these lists, so every line is this project's reading. wef30_ocean: the ten WEF skills growing fastest to 2030 (s is the index 0 to 12 in mate-wef-links.json) to the ten Ocean Decade challenges; solid (strong) where the challenge is mainly that skill, dashed (partial) where the skill is a real piece of it. ocean_mate: the ten challenges to MATE's 18 skills; solid (strong) only where MATE's own task tags reach the skill through a competency (a competency with that challenge in ocean_decade lists the skill), dashed (partial) where it is this project's reading from the two descriptions alone. tools/check_mate_data.py enforces that rule. tools/build_skills_widget_data.py writes these into the widget data file.
meta.review_status: drafts adopted for the build; the Stage C audit reviews them
